newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IPCO says full year profit outlook better.
newsitem.headline: IPCO says full year profit outlook better.

text.p: SINGAPORE, March 21 (Reuter) Construction company IPCO International Ltd said on Friday unexpected delays and cost overruns on two major projects had plunged its interim profits into the red, but it expected second half results to improve.

"Delays and cost overruns necessitated the reversal of profit which had been recognised in previous years and thus contributed to the substantial loss reported for the period," an IPCO statement said.
The company said its net loss in the six months to December 31, 1996 was Singapore $14.75 million compared to a S$1.02 million profit in the same period of 1995.
IPCO said its expectations for the second half to June 30, 1997 were substantially better, but nevertheless it expected "only a relatively small after tax profit or loss".
The completion of the delayed projects in Nigeria and Thailand and the sale of interests in a power plant in Columbia were expected to contribute positively to IPCO's second half result.
